decisions.reason: The accelerator program is not a core machinery product and has limited strategic fit, so it is dropped.
The bio-based binder is outside the firm's machinery core and likely lacks the necessary chemical production capabilities, so it is dropped.
The infectious waste decontamination plant aligns with the firm's machinery and equipment expertise and has strong partner support, so it is kept.
The mobile recycling plant is a core machinery product with clear market relevance, so it is kept.
